editor_note: Imminent hazard closure, reopened in two days with no reason given; worth a call but not urgent.
headline: Health department closes Vietopia Bistro for imminent health hazard; reopened two days later
title: Health closure: Vietopia Bistro
why_it_matters: Salt Lake County Health Department closed Vietopia Bistro at 1407 W 9000 S on Sept. 28, 2026 for an imminent health hazard; the record does not state the reason. It reopened Sept. 30.
